proposed_widenings.name: runtime-gated activated benefit
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family can model charges, Magic-action activation, dawn recharge, and a timed duration, and the surface already has `peering_through_item` as an equipment predicate. What it cannot express honestly is that the granted Truesight applies only while the bearer is actively peering through the gem during the 10-minute activated window. Encoding plain `grant_sense` on a timed activation would overstate the item as granting continuous Truesight for the full 10 minutes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

notes: Do not coerce this into a clean activation record. The missing piece is not a new atom; it is a surface-level way to gate an activated duration benefit behind a runtime predicate such as `peering_through_item`.
